fusions.name: Anchored Ram
fusions.desc: Rams an enemy from your anchor line, which deals 5 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lashed to the Crag
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Footing on the Ledge
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Hold
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
